sahneler.metin: A span of the I-5 bridge over the Skagit River collapsed into the water.
Suddenly two vehicles plunged into the river, but everyone was rescued.
An oversize load had struck the overhead beams.
The truss had no backup if those were damaged.
The bridge had been hit by a truck before.
Oversize load permits and bridge redundancy came under review.

aciklama:
Skagit River Bridge lost a span after an oversize load struck it. The cause: a fracture-critical through-truss with no redundancy once overhead members were hit.
